newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Oil denies report of unusual oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Oil denies report of unusual oil deal.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd on Tuesday denied reports that it had conducted unusual oil trading with an Osaka-based petroleum dealer, saying their dealings were normal business transactions.
The Asahi Shimbun daily reported that the company allegedly provided a total of about one billion yen to the Osaka dealer through oil deals conducted between 1990 and 1993.
"The transactions reported in the paper are part of our usual business operations, the details of which should not be disclosed," said a company spokesman.

Earlier this month, court papers in a legal dispute between Mitsubishi Oil and Mitsui Mining Co Ltd said that Mitsubishi Oil allegedly provided 2.4 billion yen to the same dealer through oil deals made between Mitsubishi and Mitsui from 1993 to 1995.
